Anika: quick summary from today's mixed-precision sweep (mistral/llama/qwen) — posting highlights and repros below.
Ethan: thanks — top-line numbers?
Anika: Mistral-7B on fp8_block path: p50 ~ same, p95 +6%, p99 +12%, throughput drop ~18% at 8k tokens/sec target. Baseline (int8_block) steady.
Mina: repro microbench: `./bench --model mistral-7b --precision fp8_block --seq 1024 --batch 8 --profile=alloc,memcpy,kv` -> 12% p99 up, memcpy spike at attention KV copy step.
Rahul: that aligns with the kernel-selector tweak we merged yesterday (commit 9a3f2b) — we changed fallback order to prefer fp8_block for hybrid-quant models which forces an extra matmul->copy path for KV on some qwen/mistral transposes.
Sara: runtime-bot posted canary: `canary-alert: mistral-v2 fp8 path high-kv-evict-rate` at 2025-09-03T11:12Z :warning:
runtime-bot: IncidentBot: Canary threshold exceeded: kv-evict-rate 0.18 (threshold 0.05) for route /generate-mistral-7b-fp8
Ethan: do we have flame graphs / traces showing where memcpy happens? Mina?
Mina: yes — attaching snippet of perf flame (paste):
```
attn_kv_copy() +0.8ms
  memcpy(kv_buffer) +0.6ms
  reorder_transpose() +0.15ms
matmul_fp8_block() +1.2ms
```
Mina: sequence-dist matters. When prefix length > 256 we see more KV writes and eviction churn because fp8 path uses a temporary contiguous buffer before KV writeback.
Rahul: root cause: fp8_block kernels currently allocate temporary NK-aligned buffer for transpose+pack which causes extra write + fallback to evict older KV pages under same memory budget. On machines with tight GPU memory (A10/NVMe-hosted nodes) that triggers swapping/evictions.
Anika: concrete proposal: revert selector rule that prefers `fp8_block` for hybrid quant_mode and add a selector heuristic: prefer fp8_block only when seq_mean < 256 AND kv_mem_pressure < 0.6.
Sara: here's a minimal config patch for runtime selector (add to model-profiles):
```
"quant_selector": {
  "prefer_fp8_block": false,
  "conditions": [
    {"seq_mean_max": 256},
    {"kv_pressure_max": 0.6}
  ]
}
```
Ethan: sounds reasonable. Also we should try lowering `dynamic_batch_timeout_ms` for fp8 routes to avoid large micro-batches that increase temp buffer lifetime.
Mina: measured impact: flipping selector -> p99 back to baseline within noise, throughput recovers ~16%. Lowering dynamic_batch_timeout_ms from 15->6ms gave an extra 4% improvement on mixed short/long workloads.
Rahul: moving forward we should add a per-model quant_profile entry: `kv_copy_strategy: pack_inplace|pack_temp` so selector can pick kernel+strategy.
Anika: Agreed. Action items:
- Rahul: open PR to revert the selector commit + add heuristic flags (today)
- Ethan: run full canary across Mistral/Llama/Qwen with `--kv-stats` and `--batch-probes` (ETA tomorrow)
- Mina: prepare microbench script and add the flame graphs to the perf doc (link below)
- Sara: add kv-evict-rate and memcpy-time to Console per-route dashboards
Sara: uploaded perf doc + flame PNGs -> https://redwood-internal.s3/profiler/mixed-prec/2025-09-mistral-kv.zip :point_up:
runtime-bot: CanaryCheck: scheduled canary replay on mistral-7b-fp8 at 2025-09-03T12:00Z
Ethan: I'll post the canary artifacts here after the run, will also try the `kv_copy_strategy` flag.
Anika: thanks team. Also request from product: collect model-specific quant profiles for Llama-2-13B and Qwen-7B to share with customers; let's make the profile format stable before exporting.
Mina: I'll make a short README for profile schema and example calibration set (100 prompts, balanced lengths) and drop in the shared folder.
Rahul: Add a Console alert rule: if kv-evict-rate increased >3x and memcpy-time > 0.5ms -> auto-fallback to int8_block for that route until manual ack.
Sara: noted, will add runbook entry for oncall.
Anika: closing loop — PRs and canary artifacts due EOD tomorrow, thanks! :thumbsup:
